sample_unit: multiple-choice questions (each queried 9 times per model)

links.outcome: Reproducibility of LLM answers across repeated sessions (Fleiss' kappa, response and correctness consistency)
links.effect: Fleiss' kappa 0.93-0.95 (almost perfect intersession agreement); response and correctness consistency 88.3% to 91.7% across models, so roughly 8-12% of questions varied across repeats.
links.quote: All three models showed almost perfect intersession agreement (Fleiss' κ = 0.93-0.95), with response and correctness consistency ranging from 88.3% to 91.7% across models.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and repeatability of three LLMs (Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT) on dental multiple-choice questions without testing specific deployment practices or safeguards.
